recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-34279 unless a later work group decision changes ConceptMap.unmapped semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-34279 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested reconciliation of FHIR-32540 and FHIR-15687 by updating ConceptMap invariant cmd-2 so ConceptMap.group.unmapped may contain either code or valueSet, but not both, in the same unmapped element.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly naming FHIR-34279 was found. The change was applied through related ConceptMap2 work: 44b6a9fc8f977d070ab90083f6d1004394e83ffc added the FHIR-15687 valueSet elements and partially applied FHIR-32540, and 520ebaf4d363671f58b5485e1c26daa18f5ddc8b made cmd-2 mutually exclusive for group.unmapped. Commit 8623473ddfcef0cb88b9abf5241abfe6e28ea542 then migrated ConceptMap2 into the current ConceptMap source.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-33061 usage notes describe group.unmapped.valueSet consistently with the same rule, later invariant cleanup added the cmd-2 condition references to unmapped.mode, unmapped.code, and unmapped.valueSet, and invariant fixtures now exercise valueSet-only pass and code-plus-valueSet failure cases.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml already states that fixed mode requires either a code or valueSet but not both, and its FHIRPath expression enforces exactly one of code or valueSet when mode is fixed.
